rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a facility, including public amenities, equipment, infrastructure, and purpose-built sites.

example.english: The facility at this sports venue is excellent.
example.traditional: 呢個運動場嘅設施幾齊全。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 wan6 dung6 coeng4 ge3 cit3 si1 gei2 cai4 cyun4

rows.note: Use this when the facility specifically means the equipment or apparatus needed to provide a service.

example.english: The facility—the gym equipment—is brand new.
example.traditional: 呢間健身室嘅設備好新。
example.jyutping: nei1 gaan1 gin6 san1 sat1 ge3 cit3 bei6 hou2 san1

rows.note: Use this for a purpose-built venue or building used for activities, rather than for a prison, military installation, or laboratory in general.

example.english: This purpose-built facility hosts lots of major events every year.
example.traditional: 呢個場館每年都搞好多大型活動。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 coeng4 gun2 mui5 nin4 dou1 gaau2 hou2 do1 daai6 jing4 wut6 dung6
